comparison.objective: Mount and align a dogbone specimen in two tensile-tester wedge grips at a specified gauge length, versus set and lock a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-2186 requires two-ended specimen insertion, spring-lever operation, straightening, and crosshead jogging; the candidate requires coaxial screw/nut tool coordination and countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: PR-2186 scores independent tab seating, lever closure, end clearances, 115 mm jaw spacing, alignment, clearance, and a three-second hold; the candidate requires retained stop angle and repeated gripper cycles.
comparison.reason: Precision specimen fixturing in two clamps tests distributed insertion and alignment, not preservation of a threaded adjustment against locknut reaction.
